search_text: published ZDI-23-084 ZDI-CAN-19416 Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master CtrlLayerNWCmd_FileOperation Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-01-18 CVE-2022-41657 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-41657 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Delta Electronics'] ['InfraSuite Device Master'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within CtrlLayerNWCmd_FileOperation function. When parsing the fileName element, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of an administrator. Delta Electronics has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master CtrlLayerNWCmd_FileOperation Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Electronics InfraSuite Device Master. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within CtrlLayerNWCmd_FileOperation function. When parsing the fileName element, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of an administrator.
